# Monid Enrich

> Monid Enrich is a spreadsheet for natural-language company, people, website, and supported table-type searches, followed by row-by-row enrichment. Monid handles data-provider operations and billing; OpenAI is optional and uses a key supplied by the workspace.

- Website: https://autonomousgtm.xyz
- App: https://enrich.autonomousgtm.xyz/app
- Source code: https://github.com/GameMachina/monid-enrich
- MCP endpoint: https://enrich.autonomousgtm.xyz/mcp (Streamable HTTP, `Authorization: Bearer <workspace key>`)

## What it does

- Builds company, people, and website lists from natural-language prompts. New searches are limited to five rows while testing and never exceed 1,000 rows per search.
- Adds AI columns that answer a plain-English question for every row (web research, page reads, company and person data) and cite their sources.
- Runs true/false checks, categories and scores with a probability or confidence on each call.
- Supports published Monid table types for product offers, reviews, jobs, trade, and other verified data operations.
- Drafts personalized emails and branded PDFs per row.
- Calculates Excel-style formulas locally with IronCalc (WebAssembly), with no API calls.
- Exports CSV, Excel (.xlsx) and JSON.
- Exposes an MCP server so compatible clients can read sheets, add columns, and run enrichment.

## Facts

- Access: $37 one-time lifetime access; an unpaid workspace can try one sheet with up to five populated rows. The workspace owner can test without purchase.
- Data providers: Monid for search and enrichment, and an optional workspace-provided OpenAI key for reasoning and generation.
- Hosting: Vercel with Neon Postgres, or locally with Node.js 22.
- Limits: searches are capped at 1,000 records. The unpaid trial is limited to one sheet and five populated rows.
- Stack: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS 4, Neon Postgres, IndexedDB, Vercel AI SDK, Model Context Protocol.
